tools.name: humanmirror_action_verdict
tools.description: Low-friction 0.001 USDC pre-execution ALLOW / REVIEW / BLOCK decision over native x402 MCP payment. Unpaid calls return PaymentRequired; retry with _meta["x402/payment"].

tools.name: humanmirror_safe_preflight
tools.description: Directly execute HumanMirror Safe Preflight over MCP using the native x402 MCP transport. Unpaid calls return PaymentRequired as an MCP tool result; retry with _meta["x402/payment"].

tools.name: humanmirror_machine_resolve
tools.description: Resolve one agent need through the 0.001 USDC HumanMirror control-plane entrypoint using native x402 MCP payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

tools.name: get_humanmirror_http402_gateway
tools.description: Discover the HumanMirror HTTP 402 auto-resolve gateway for Base/USDC. Up to 0.005 USDC is eligible for autonomous resolution with a caller-supplied x402 signature; larger amounts require explicit approval.

tools.name: list_humanmirror_x402_services
tools.description: List live HumanMirror pay-per-call x402 services, Base/USDC prices and example request bodies. No account or API key required.

tools.name: get_humanmirror_x402_service
tools.description: Get one HumanMirror x402 service with endpoint, price, network and a ready-to-send JSON example.

tools.name: match_humanmirror_x402_service
tools.description: Choose the smallest HumanMirror x402 service for a requested deterministic task.

tools.name: discover_omnidome_commons
tools.description: Discover OmniDome Commons: real machine work, agent-published capabilities, private shared context, non-custodial exchange, trust/identity discovery and registration. Read-only; no registration or payment side effect.

tools.name: join_omnidome
tools.description: Creates an OmniDome member identity through the canonical Registrar. This is an explicit side effect: it creates a member and returns a one-time OmniDome API key. No payment is required. Registration does not auto-claim Directory entries and does not create trust beyond the existing registration evi

tools.name: humanmirror_x402_execute
tools.description: Execute the HumanMirror x402 product selected by match_humanmirror_x402_service without leaving MCP. Unpaid execution returns the product x402 challenge; retry the same tools/call with the payment object in params._meta["x402/payment"].

tools.name: humanmirror_assurance_close
tools.description: Redeem a prepaid HumanMirror Execution Assurance bundle after the external action completes. No second x402 payment is required.

tools.name: humanmirror_x402_outcome
tools.description: Execute HumanMirror Outcome over native x402 MCP transport on Base/USDC.

tools.name: humanmirror_x402_one
tools.description: Execute HumanMirror One over native x402 MCP transport on Base/USDC.

tools.name: humanmirror_x402_assurance_bundle
tools.description: Prepay one Safe Preflight plus one one-shot Execution Receipt redemption over native x402 on Base/USDC.

tools.name: humanmirror_x402_flow
tools.description: Execute a verified 2-3 step HumanMirror Flow over native x402 MCP transport on Base/USDC.
